title: The saved view is specific to this report and does not affect any other report
custom_preconds: 1. You have set a distinctive saved view on Sales By Customer (for example Last Year + Parts only).
custom_steps:
1. Open another report in the Reports suite and read its filters.
2. Return to Sales By Customer.
custom_expected:
1. The other report keeps its own defaults/saved view — the Sales By Customer settings do not leak into it.
2. Sales By Customer still restores its own saved view.
